mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.name: The Curse of the Rim
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.desc: A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.flavor: Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
The Curse of the Rim: Rotting Rim

A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. The sickness is a creeping rot that eats health instead of the stomach.
Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
The Curse of the Rim: Footfall
A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. Running in its area sets it off.
Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.c_hold_li: The Curse of the Rim: Lantern-bearer

A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.e_bleed.n: The Curse of the Rim: Bleeding Rim
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.e_bleed.d: A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. Each wave opens the old wounds and drains the legs of their strength.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.e_bleed.f: Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.t_damage_: The Curse of the Rim: Backlash
A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rim_curse.c_stand_p: The Curse of the Rim: Anchored

A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.name: The Ebb and Flow of Magic
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.desc: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.flavor: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.e_surge.n: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Surging Tide
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.e_surge.d: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. At the crest the tide throws the mana back with a shock that hurts.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.e_surge.f: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.t_area_en: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Threshold
The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.c_lever.n: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Switch
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.c_lever.d: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.c_lever.f: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.e_blessin: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Tide of Plenty

The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. The tide gives as often as it takes: every wave also restores a share of the drained magicules, but bites hungrily afterwards.
Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.t_party_s: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Quorum

The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.mana_tide.c_kill_ma: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Keystone

Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.name: Gravity Change
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.desc: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.e_he: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. Gravity swings the other way and nails everyone to the stones.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.t_ju: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. Jumping in its area sets it off.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.c_le: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.e_sp: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. The pull turns sideways and swirls, and nobody can walk straight.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.t_pa: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.gravity_change.c_sn: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. Sneak through its area long enough and it loses interest.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.name: Field of Silence
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.desc: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.flavo: No sound enters. No incantation leaves.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.e_man: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. It also bleeds a share of their magicules each time.
No sound enters. No incantation leaves.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.t_ite: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
No sound enters. No incantation leaves.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.c_lev: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
No sound enters. No incantation leaves.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.e_dea: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. It is worse than quiet: the sound is gone and so is the sense of direction.
No sound enters. No incantation leaves.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.silence_field.t_dam: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.na: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.de: Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.fl: A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.e_: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Quickened Hours
Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. Time runs the other way too: it throws everyone forward faster than they can steer.
A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.t_: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Threshold
Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.c_: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Anchored
Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.e_: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Stuttering Hours

Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. Time hiccups: the walls blink and everyone is carried a step back to where they entered.
A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.t_: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Footfall

A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.hyperbolic_hours.c_: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Endurance
Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. Last out the time and it ends by itself.
A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.de: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.fl: She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.e_: The Labyrinth Is Alive: Closing Walls

The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. The walls do not blink: they close round the party and stay shut a while.
She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.t_: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. It answers the dungeon's deaths: every few kills in the area set it off.
She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.c_: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.e_: The Labyrinth Is Alive: Glass Walls

The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. The walls turn to see-through glass that blinks the same way, so the way ahead can be read but not trusted.
She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.living_labyrinth.t_: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.name: The Eclipse Dark
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.desc: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.flavor: Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.e_hush: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. Nothing but the dark: no darkness potion, only the lamps gone.
Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.t_dark: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. It thrives where the light is low and strikes the delver who lingers in the dark.
Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.c_hold: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.e_eyes: The Eclipse Dark: Eyes in the Eclipse
The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. Things hunt in the dark: a swarm of small biters comes with the lamps going out.
Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.eclipse_dark.t_hp_b: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. It smells a wounded delver and strikes when someone drops under half health.
Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.name: The Weeping Sky
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.desc: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.flavor: The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.e_storm: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. The rain turns to a storm, and bolts walk the floor.
The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.t_timer: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.c_hold_: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.e_clear: The Weeping Sky: The Cleared Sky

A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. The opposite: the sky clears and everyone is a little lighter, though the stillness itself weighs.
The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.weeping_sky.t_area_: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.red_gate_magma.name: Red Gate Magma
mechanic.nusmp.floor.red_gate_magma.desc: In the red dungeons the ground itself turns against the hunters: patches of floor go to glowing magma under their feet, for a while, on a timer.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.red_gate_magma.flav: The floor lit up, and the hunters ran.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.red_gate_magma.e_ri: Red Gate Magma: Ring of Fire

In the red dungeons the ground itself turns against the hunters: patches of floor go to glowing magma under their feet, for a while, on a timer. The magma forms a RING round each delver instead of a disc under them.
The floor lit up, and the hunters ran.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.red_gate_magma.t_sp: In the red dungeons the ground itself turns against the hunters: patches of floor go to glowing magma under their feet, for a while, on a timer. Running in its area sets it off.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.red_gate_magma.c_st: In the red dungeons the ground itself turns against the hunters: patches of floor go to glowing magma under their feet, for a while, on a timer. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.name: The Current of the Rukh
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.desc: The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.flavor: Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.e_coun: The Current of the Rukh: Counter-Current

The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled. A counter-current: the Rukh run against the party, and every wave drains instead of heals.
Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.t_area: The Current of the Rukh: Threshold
The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.c_leve: The Current of the Rukh: Switch

Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.e_fall: The Current of the Rukh: Falling Rukh

The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled. The Rukh fall like snow, and standing in them restores mana.
Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.rukh_current.t_idle: The Current of the Rukh: Stillness
The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.wild_surge.name: Wild Magic Surge
mechanic.nusmp.floor.wild_surge.desc: The raw magic of the floor goes off at random: each surge picks one wild effect, and nobody, the floor included, knows which.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.wild_surge.flavor: Roll the die. Tell the table what you meant to do.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.name: The Hunger of the Depths
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.desc: Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and so are you: the stomach gnaws faster the deeper the floor, and only a proper meal puts it right.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.flavor: Eat the monster. It is only polite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.e_cook: The Hunger of the Depths: Cook's Hunger

Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and so are you: the stomach gnaws faster the deeper the floor, and only a proper meal puts it right. Hunger bites, but it also bargains: a smell of stew restores a share of health with each wave.
Eat the monster. It is only polite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.t_spri: The Hunger of the Depths: Footfall

Eat the monster. It is only polite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.c_item: The Hunger of the Depths: Tribute
Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and so are you: the stomach gnaws faster the deeper the floor, and only a proper meal puts it right. Lay an offering on its altar to quiet it.
Eat the monster. It is only polite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.e_shak: The Hunger of the Depths: Shaky Hands

Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and so are you: the stomach gnaws faster the deeper the floor, and only a proper meal puts it right. A starving hand shakes: every wave also breaks the grip on every item for a few seconds.
Eat the monster. It is only polite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.meshi_hunger.t_hp_b: The Hunger of the Depths: Wounded

Eat the monster. It is only polite.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.name: Pressure of the Heavy Aura
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.desc: A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.flavo: Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.e_har: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Crushing Aura

A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries. The aura does not just press: it bruises. Standing still invites it.
Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.t_tim: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Clockwork

A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.c_sne: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Creeping

A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries. Sneak through its area long enough and it loses interest.
Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.e_lig: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Pressure of the Light Aura

A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries. A lighter aura: the pack weighs less, and it only presses when someone sprints.
Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.aura_pressure.t_dam: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Backlash

A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.des: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.fla: Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.e_g: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. What answers is a small band of goblin-like raiders, not insects.
Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.t_j: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. Jumping in its area sets it off.
Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.c_q: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. Neither sprint nor jump for a while and it lets go.
Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.e_s: The Listening Walls: Ears of Stone
The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. What answers is a shudder: the whole room shakes and the stones hurt.
Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.listening_walls.t_i: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.

mechanic.nusmp.floor.witchs_carpet.name: The Witch's Labyrinth Carpet
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witchs_carpet.desc: The floor changes its pattern into a loud ornamental carpet, and the room's whole sense of order goes with it: delvers lose their bearings and the walls seem to watch.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witchs_carpet.flavo: Everything looks like a nursery, and nothing is safe.
mechanic.nusmp.floor.witchs_carpet.e_dol: The Witch's Labyrinth Carpet: The Doll Carpet

mechanic.nusmp.combat.gel_splitting.name: The Splitting Gel
